units.source_text: 这里的青年侍女久慕源氏公子盖世无双的美貌，对他这行为都原谅，并不大惊小怪。

en.t: The young gentlewomen here had long admired Prince Genji's incomparable beauty, so they forgave this behavior of his and were not greatly shocked.

units.source_text: 只觉得此事突如其来，小姐不曾提防，定然十分困窘。

en.t: They only felt that the incident had come so suddenly that the young lady, unprepared for it, must surely be deeply embarrassed.

units.source_text: 至于小姐本人呢，只是神思恍惚，羞羞答答地躲躲闪闪。

en.t: As for the young lady herself, she was simply dazed and distracted, bashfully shrinking away and evading him.

units.source_text: 源氏公子想：“在这时候取这态度，倒是可爱的。

en.t: Prince Genji thought, "For her to take this attitude at such a time is rather charming.

units.source_text: 可见她是个从小娇生惯养、还没见过世面的人。”便原谅她的缺点。

en.t: It shows that she has been pampered since childhood and has not yet seen the world." So he forgave her shortcomings.

units.source_text: 可是总觉得有一种莫名其妙的异样之感，并无牵惹人情之处。

en.t: Yet he still felt a strange, inexplicable awkwardness about her, and there was nothing in her that stirred his affections.

units.source_text: 失望之余，他就在深夜起身出去了。

en.t: Disappointed, he rose in the depth of the night and went out.

units.source_text: 大辅命妇一直担心，不能入睡，只是睁开眼睛躺着。

en.t: Taifu no Myobu had been worried all along and could not sleep; she only lay there with her eyes open.

units.source_text: 她想还是装作不知的好。

en.t: She thought it would be best to pretend she knew nothing.

units.source_text: 因此听见源氏公子出去，她并不起来送客。

en.t: Therefore, when she heard Prince Genji leaving, she did not get up to see him off.

units.source_text: 源氏公子偷偷摸摸地走出这邸宅去了。

en.t: Prince Genji slipped quietly out of the residence.
